sources.title: Model AI Assignments
sources.snippet: Model AI Assignments is the largest, open-access, peer-reviewed AI assignment repository. Accepted assignments are presented in sessions at the Educational Advances in Artificial Intelligence Symposium, collocated with AAAI.

sources.title: Towards Human-AI Complementarity in Matching Tasks
sources.snippet: In this work, we have introduced CoMatch, a hybrid decision-support framework aimed at achieving human-AI complementarity in matching tasks, with a particular focus on identifying how many decisions to defer in large-scale matching tasks.
